Notes: We deviate a bit to avoid getting into IBES detail file.  Since we only use the summary file, we screen stdev > 0 and also keep both 4th and 5th quintiles of dispersion.
Detailed Definition: Follow RIO\_MB, except define Disp as the stdev of IBES forecasts where fpi == 1 divided by at, and sort on Disp instead of MB.  Finally, let RIO\_Disp = lagged RIO quntile if the Disp quintile >= 4.
